# Optional integration fixtures

The core tests create their own temporary data. Two additional tests use specific external sample files and are skipped when those samples are absent.

Place these exact samples here only if you have permission to use and share them:

- Python Tutorial.pdf: the original tutorial sample with the tax example expected by the test.
- Supermarket-Sales-Sample-Data.xlsx: the original sample with header row 8 and expected tax total 93.984.

Arbitrary files with the same name are not valid substitutes. No user documents are bundled. These fixtures are optional and are not required to launch the app.
